[SWS_CM_10267] Insertion of an associative map length field
⌈
If attribute
TransformationPropsToServiceInterfaceElementMappingSet.mapping.
transformationProps.sizeOfArrayLengthField is not set and attribute
SomeipDataPrototypeTransformationProps.someipTransformation-
Props.sizeOfArrayLengthField is not set, a length field of 4 bytes with the
data type uint32 shall be inserted in front of the serialized associative map.
⌋
